title: How far each blind playtester got in Planetfall
maxScoreSource: source/verbs.zil:227 ("(out of 80 points)"), and verbs.zil:240, where the rank Galactic Overlord is exactly 80; the port prints the same line (wwwroot/engine/verbs.js:34).
method: Every number is read from the session transcripts that scripts/playtest.mjs wrote (scripts/out/playtest/<session>-transcript.txt). Each game response ends in a status line "-- <room> · turn N · time T · score S", with "YOU HAVE DIED" or "GAME WON" appended when that happens; commands are the lines beginning "> ".

Best score is the highest score on any status line; final score is the score on the last status line of play; deaths count the "****  You have died  ****" banners (the status line repeats while dead, and the repeats are not counted).

Each diary was then checked against those numbers, and the diary line that states them is cited beside the transcript line. Where the two disagree the transcript is used and the difference is given in a note.
The transcripts are local files and are not in git (.gitignore: scripts/out/); the diaries in playtests/ are.
Commands include everything sent to the game: free actions such as save and restore, click-mode submenu openings, and commands answered while dead.
missing: None. Every one of the 36 diaries in playtests/ has a transcript, and every tester's score was found.

testers.note: Three games: two deaths on the Feinstein (attacked Blather; missed the pod), then a third game to turn 245.

Died at 42 at turn 499, then restarted once from the checkpoint only to confirm it (diary line 182), so the transcript's last line reads 21. The final score here is the score at the death that ended play.
Both deaths ended the game: restore after death did not work on that build, so each was a restart from the checkpoint (diary line 118).
Three deaths, each restored from a save.
Won twice: 74 of 80 at turn 409 on its second attempt (transcript line 4957), then restarted from the checkpoint by choice and won 80 of 80 at turn 369 (diary line 73 explains the restart).
Leg 3 was not strictly blind (playtests/README.md); its score did not move.

The diary's report (line 435) says two deaths by starvation in leg 1; the transcript has one death (line 8174). The other rollback in leg 1 was a restore while alive, to undo a smeared access card (diary line 92).

Best 44 in leg 2, which ended in death with no save; leg 3 restarted from the beginning twice and ended alive at 30. The diary's verdict (line 994) counts three deaths; the transcript has five: one on the Feinstein in leg 1, starvation at the end of leg 2, and three in leg 3's first fresh run (drowned, then starved twice, each restored from that run's save) before it started again from the beginning.
Leg 2 was a restart from the beginning after leg 1 drowned at 15.

The leg 1 report (line 417) counts three deaths; the transcript has four (a second, 13-turn game that died waiting on the Feinstein is not in the diary). The leg 2 report (line 783) says "roughly a dozen deaths"; the transcript has 22 deaths from command 1127 on, six of them in the first leg 2 attempt that was cut off before writing anything.
The leg 2 report (line 1073) counts three deaths; the transcript has four in leg 2 (radiation poisoning twice).
Died at turn 13 waiting out the escape pod window with no save, and started again. The README counts 438 commands; the transcript has 427 lines beginning "> ".
Its goal was Lawanda Platform, and it stopped there on arrival. The diary and README say about 275 commands; the transcript has 260.

The checkpoint now steps off at turn 260 (transcript line 29); in round eight it was turn 256, since the checkpoint plays the walkthrough until Lawanda Platform on the current build. One death (radiation, Radiation Lock West, at 54), restored. The diary says about 195 commands; the transcript has 214.

Won 68 of 80, rank System Captain: the ending with Planetary Defense and communications still broken. The diary (line 169) counts six deaths, three in each leg; the transcript has four death banners (the Feinstein, the undertow, and the microbe twice). Its third try at the microbe was restored before a death banner, and leg 1's kitchen-card soft-lock was restored away without one. The diary says about 680 commands; the transcript has 693.

The first persona run (a first-time 14-year-old). Life 1 died of hunger on the Dorm Corridor walk at turn 318 with score 25, never having saved, and restarted (transcript line 8081); life 2 stopped alive in the Kitchen at turn 105, score 23. The diary says about 450 commands; the transcript has 439.

Played as an adult who played the original once in 1983. The session was run under the name r18, so its transcript is r18-transcript.txt; the checkpoint steps off at turn 260 (transcript line 29). Won 80 of 80, Galactic Overlord, 171 turns from the checkpoint, with no deaths, in 183 commands.

testers.finalState: Robot Shop, turn 87 after a restore, saved
testers.note: Played as a first-time player typing plain modern English. The session was run under the name r19, so its transcript is r19-transcript.txt. It reached 13 at Kalamontee Platform, then died at the rift (turn 134) and restored its only save, from the Crag; it stopped alive and saved in the Robot Shop at turn 87 with score 9, so its best (13) is above its final (9). The diary says roughly 190 commands counting refused ones; the transcript has 244 lines beginning "> ".

testers.finalState: Cryo-Anteroom, turn 627 of game 2, GAME WON
testers.note: Played as an adult who knows Zork and its kind but has never played Planetfall, seed 20, in three legs. Game 1 reached 42 (transcript line 14540) and died five times: the Feinstein at turn 16, the Bio Lab door at 410, and three collapses from lack of sleep at 510-512, each restored to a save made at 507 that had no way on; it restarted at transcript line 15030 after 585 commands. Game 2 won 80 of 80, Galactic Overlord, at turn 627, in 740 commands, with five deaths, all restored: the Bio Lab door, radiation poisoning twice and the microbe twice. The diary counts about 397, 395 and 305 commands for its three legs (about 1,100); the transcript has 1,325 lines beginning "> ".

Played as a millennial only vaguely aware of text adventures, click only from the start, seed 21, in two legs. Leg 1 stopped at turn 183 in Dorm Corridor, score 17, when the session's permission system refused the harness call for its next move, soon after a coordinator note in the diary raised the leg budget to 750 commands (diary lines 59 and 65); a fresh agent played leg 2 from the handoff. The game won 80 of 80, Galactic Overlord, at turn 701, with two deaths, both restored: the Infirmary bed at turn 522 and the microbe at turn 675. Floyd's death in the Bio Lab is not a player death. The diary counts about 185 and about 480 commands for its legs (lines 65 and 217); the transcript has 197 lines beginning "> " up to the stop (line 4919) and 819 in all.

Played as a first-time 14-year-old who has never seen a text adventure, click only from the start, seed 22, in one leg. Won 74 of 80, Cluster Admiral, at turn 623: Planetary Defense was never repaired, so the ending says a second Stellar Patrol ship was destroyed by the meteor defenses (transcript line 18026; diary lines 186 and 188). The tester read the missing six points as the pliers offering no "take with" on the shocking boards (diary friction row 37). One death, restored: the Infirmary bed at turn 557. The diary counts about 600 commands (line 194); the transcript has 666 lines beginning "> ". The first teen persona to finish; round 17's never left Kalamontee.

Played as an adult who knows Zork and its kind but has never played Planetfall, typed from the start, seed 23, in two legs, on main before rounds twenty-one and twenty-two's fixes were merged. Won 80 of 80, Galactic Overlord, at turn 723, in one game. Ten deaths, all restored: the Infirmary bed at turn 501, the Bio Lab mutants five times at Bio Lock East (turns 533 to 594), the Radiation Lab twice and the microbe twice. The tester numbers its deaths up to nine (diary line 491). It also restored once while alive, at turn 267, after locking the kitchen card inside the kitchen (diary line 135). Floyd's death in the Bio Lab is not a player death. The diary counts about 750 and roughly 175 commands for its legs (lines 350 and 527); the transcript has 764 lines beginning "> " up to the Kitchen save at turn 575 (line 3945) and 996 in all.

lifeByLife.about: The runs from the start, played in legs (rounds 10 to 12), life by life. A life ends in a death, a win, a restore or restart while alive, or the end of the session. "began" says how a life started: a fresh game from the beginning (--new), or a restored save. commands is the range of the session's command count the life covers; steps are [command, score] at each change of score.
